_comment: Branches on the invoice status the backend already derived from days_elapsed (nudged/noticed/overdue), instead of re-checking day thresholds here, so the escalation ladder has one source of truth. The 'ElevenLabs API' n8n credential must send the xi-api-key header (ElevenLabs' auth header, not Authorization).
name: Vasooli 03 - Escalation Ladder

parameters.content: nudged/noticed -> outbound reminder call. overdue -> refresh the Samadhaan complaint draft. pending/called/paid -> no action this cycle.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { agent_id: $env.ELEVENLABS_OUTBOUND_AGENT_ID, agent_phone_number_id: $env.ELEVENLABS_OUTBOUND_PHONE_NUMBER_ID, to_number: $json.buyer_phone, conversation_initiation_client_data: { dynamic_variables: { msme_name: $json.msme_name, buyer_name: $json.buyer_name, invoice_number: $json.invoice_number, amount: $json.amount, days_elapsed: $json.days_elapsed, escalation_stage: $json.status } } } }}
